newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran, Russia, Ukraine in project to build plane.
newsitem.headline: Iran, Russia, Ukraine in project to build plane.

text.p: Iran, Russia and Ukraine are working together to manufacture 60-seat "simorgh" transport aircraft, the official IRNA news agency said on Sunday.
It quoted Roads and Transport Minister Akbar Torkan as saying the three sides would build 240 airplanes. Iran would take delivery of 80 such planes, he added.
Torkan said his country was considering another project to build 120-seat jets.
"The project is to be put into practice soon...it will be worked out in the next ten years to manufacture 50 airplanes at first stage," IRNA quoted him as saying.
Torkan, speaking during a ceremony attended by President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani to mark the 35th anniversary of Iranian civil aviation, gave no further details.

Earlier last year Ukraine's Antonov airplane designer and manufacturer won a tender from Iran to build a plant capable of producing ten models of its latest An-140 short-haul turbo-prop transport aircraft planes.
